blurb: This check verifies that AIX CDE conceals the display, via the session lock, within a short window as DISA STIG V-215212 requires. It reads the CDE install state and every dtsession*saverTimeout and dtsession*lockTimeout value in the /etc/dt/config/*/sys.resources site files, failing when a site config file is missing or any timeout exceeds 15 minutes. When CDE (X11) is not used, the control is Not Applicable.
